Day 0-3: access + config + security review
Day 4-10: integration + smoke tests
Day 11-14: enablement + training session
Day 15-30: pilot, quality checks, iterate prompts
Day 30: production handover + renewal health review
```

- API keys created & scoped

- KV/prefix cache configured
- Latency baseline test script: run ./bench_chat.sh --concurrency 10
```
